recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast graphic composition featuring large, interlocking block lettering containing duotone photographic textures, set against a stark white background with secondary rounded sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Interlocking relationship between uppercase block letters and lowercase rounded script
Duotone photographic fill within the primary letterforms
Complementary color contrast between vibrant orange and deep purple
Geometric rigidity of the background vs. organic textures in the fills
coreInvariants: Halftone or high-contrast photo textures inside letters
Star motifs integrated into circular letter counters

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally justified typographic block occupying the middle horizontal third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, heavy uppercase letterforms that act as a window for the photographic content.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left metadata text, drops into the large central block, and follows the interlocking lowercase line to the bottom-right credit.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the central graphic, creating a clean, modern frame for the busy internal textures.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation orange against a dark, low-value purple creates a vibrating edge effect typical of 1970s psychedelic print.

letterConstructionRules: Primary letters are ultra-bold, slab-like blocks with no internal spacing between characters.
Secondary letters are rounded, lowercase, and interlocking with the primary block.
Circular counters in lowercase letters contain five-pointed stars.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'g' and 'o' are perfectly circular to accommodate star icons.
The 'v' and 'm' are constructed from thick, uniform-width rectangles.

composition.relationshipToImage: Contains the image as a mask

composition.position: Top left and bottom right of main block

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Scale contrast between massive block display and small rounded geometric sans.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the primary block masking.
Matches the rounded, geometric lowercase aesthetic of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a clean white canvas. In the center, generate a large horizontal rectangular composition of interlocking geometric shapes. Fill these shapes with high-contrast, duotone (orange and purple) grainy photographic textures of faces and figures in a 1970s rock style.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a thin purple stroke to the central geometric block. Overlay rounded lowercase sans-serif text in the top-left and bottom-right corners of the central block using solid orange and purple. Ensure circular letters in the lower text contain small five-pointed stars.

verificationChecks: Are the photos inside the letters strictly duotone orange and purple?
Do the lowercase 'o' and 'g' characters contain stars?
Is the main text block interlocking without gaps?

postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleed between orange and purple
Ensure text is legible despite the heavy masking
Verify the white border is uniform
Confirm stars are centered in circular counters
recipe.reuseFormula: Heavy block typography + duotone photo mask + rounded geometric secondary text + star icons + white negative space.
